display.purpose: Shared fluid page heading: clamp(26px,3vw,40px), 1.3 line-height, maximum 27ch.

report-tab.purpose: Four mode labels: 12px desktop; 11px at <=1200px; 12px at <=980px; 11px at <=700px.

batch-total.purpose: Batch summary strip values; historical strip uses 22px; batch values use 19px at <=700px.

shadows.name: sticky-column-rule
shadows.purpose: Structural separator beside the sticky project column.

motion.name: anchor-scroll
motion.purpose: Default anchor scrolling; reduced motion removes smooth scrolling. Coverage mode/project changes return immediately to the top.

focus.projectSelection: Focus moves to the main-column project-detail heading; coverage.js then returns immediately to the top.
focus.batchSelection: Focus moves to the main-column run-detail heading; coverage.js then returns immediately to the top.

extensions.previewNotes: Tonal ramps are synthesized OKLCH display metadata, not application tokens. Snippets retain actual CSS variables with literal fallbacks. Static specimens show the finished coverage.css cascade; app.js, batches.js and coverage.js supply selection, keyboard, URL and tooltip behavior. Review screenshots are development evidence; no raster imagery ships in the report.

icons.note: Authored unfilled paths in batches.js; text-only brand. Existing header download uses an 18px SVG with 1.5px stroke and is hidden at <=760px.

print.purpose: Paper-specific root colors keep inherited captions and status signals legible on white; screen frontmatter tokens are unchanged.

max700.pairedValues: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); each value labelled by data-cohort

layout.navigation: Header actions select overview, four-cohort comparison or criteria. Project selection opens detail in the reading column; historical section navigation is static and preserves all seven sections.

evidence.scope: Documentation refresh only; no UI or data changes and no recapture.

narrative.overview:
Dark scientific publication tables give the report a quiet, precise working character. Flat charcoal surfaces, readable Korean system typography and restrained signals keep measurements easy to scan. The user-pinned coverage reference governs the actual composition: a compact full-width header, persistent project rail and inset reading column. Matching its palette alone does not satisfy this direction.

Evidence and annotation have separate space. Numeric tables carry exact reading, while interactive plot marks expose distribution. Four explicit model/mode tabs begin with Claude normal and retain its existing analysis. Native controls, visible keyboard focus and project detail within the main column support repeated inspection without decorative imagery or external fonts.
keyCharacteristics: Coverage-matched header, project rail and inset reading column.
Four model/mode tabs with Claude normal first and selected by default.
Flat charcoal surfaces, fine structural rules and blue selected controls.
Separate, labelled color meanings for pipeline stages, cohorts and termination states.
Tabular numerals, native controls and project-focused detail.
A mobile project selector, two-by-two mode tabs and labelled comparison values.
Authored SVG icons with text or accessible status labels.

rules.name: The Stage Meaning Rule
rules.body: In historical pipeline charts, green identifies storyboard, blue identifies first scene, and amber identifies followup requests. Keep the same mapping in text, tables and circle, square or diamond marks.

rules.name: The Context Label Rule
rules.body: Cohort keys identify Claude normal and GPT AI in blue, Claude AI in green and GPT normal in amber. Termination icons independently identify model complete in green, turn limit in amber and supplier error in red. Keep the model/mode or status label beside its color; termination is not a quality judgment.

rules.name: The Numeric Reading Rule
rules.body: Right-align measurements and use tabular numerals; keep labels, units, denominators and missing-record wording visible. Mobile comparison values may align left beneath explicit field labels.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Use tone and fine rules for structure. Reserve the ambient shadow for the floating chart tooltip.

dos: Do preserve the coverage header, project rail and inset reading column as well as its palette.
Do keep Claude normal first and selected by default in the four model/mode tabs.
Do preserve the Korean system sans stack and monospace identifiers.
Do pair pipeline color with text and circle, square or diamond marks.
Do keep cohort identity and termination semantics labelled separately.
Do retain visible focus, keyboard-operable tabs and plot marks, and focus transfer to detail.
Do use the mobile project selector and explicitly label each of the four reflowed comparison values.
Do keep remaining wide tables in their own scroll regions.
Do use authored SVG icons with accessible labels for controls and statuses.
donts: Don't reduce coverage alignment to a palette change or restore the old centered, rail-free shell.
Don't make comparison a fifth model/mode tab or rename preserved Claude normal content as an anonymous archive.
Don't add decorative imagery, external fonts, gradients or oversized marketing headings.
Don't replace analytical tables with metric-card grids.
Don't use pipeline, cohort or status colors interchangeably or as arbitrary decoration.
Don't treat a model-complete or turn-limit indicator as a quality score.
Don't add elevation to ordinary panels or introduce motion beyond the existing state transitions.
